name: Channel-Cut Fracture
strange: Capacity is achieved by a measure-zero set of distributions.
renaming: It inverts the arrow of convergence: the limit exists but the sequence does not.
raw:
NAME: Channel-Cut Fracture
GENESIS: Erasing the continuity axiom of the channel from the Shannon capacity limit.
FORMAL_SEED: $C = \sup \{\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n \log \frac{1}{p_i}\}$
STRANGE_PROPERTY: Capacity is achieved by a measure-zero set of distributions.
NEAREST_KNOWN_RELATIVE: Entropy Limit (Gledd).
WHY_NOT_JUST_RENAMING: It inverts the arrow of convergence: the limit exists but the sequence does not.
COUNTERFEIT: Entropy Rate Limit (Gledd's).
BREAK_IT: $n \to \infty$ is a lie.
NEXT_MUTATION: Apply to topological basis.
